title: Structured Web resource document
description: Canonical resource description, format v0.1. Properties not listed here are allowed so a newer writer can add fields and a v0.1 reader can ignore them.

version.description: Format version. Agents select a parser from this semver string.

id.description: Durable, globally unique identifier for this resource.

type.description: Resource type name from a registered vocabulary. Membership is checked against vocabularies/core.json by the validator, not by an enum in this schema, so a later vocabulary does not require a new format draft.

title.description: Human-readable title. Agents may use it as a display label.

content.description: Typed payload. The object shape comes from the vocabulary content schema for type.

action.description: One declared action. name is unique within the resource; the validator enforces that, since JSON Schema has no standard unique-property keyword.

name.description: Invocation name, unique within the resource.

description.description: What the action does, in plain language.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema object for the arguments the caller must supply. The validator checks that this object is itself a valid draft 2020-12 schema.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema object for a successful result. The validator checks that this object is itself a valid draft 2020-12 schema.

preconditions.description: Predicate strings that must hold before invocation. Evaluation is not done in this layer.

effects.description: Predicate strings describing state changes. Evaluation is not done in this layer.

risk.description: Impact classification. High and critical actions require consent or pre-authorization in the agent runtime.

idempotent.description: Whether repeated identical calls are safe.

provenance.description: Where this data came from. signed_by may be null in v0.1. This layer does not verify the digest or a signature.

content_hash.description: Content digest. Examples use sha256:<64 hex>. Equality with the body is not checked.

signed_by.description: Signer identity, or null when the document is unsigned.

render.description: Optional rendering hints. A client may ignore them.
